test.create_query: CREATE TABLE json_src (s String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO json_src SELECT concat( '{"metadata":{"uid":"', toString(generateUUIDv4()), '","product":{"name":"p', toString(number % 40), '","vendor_name":"v', toString(number % 40), '"}},', '"class_uid":', toString(number % 7), ',"severity_id":', toString(number % 5), ',"message":"m', toString(number), '",', '"src_endpoint":{"ip":"10.0.', toString(number % 256), '.1","port":', toString(number % 65536), '},', '"unmapped":{"f', toString(number % 320), '":1},', '"raw":{', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> concat('"k', toString((number % 40) * 30 + i), '":"x', toString(i), '"'), range(30)), ','), '}}') FROM numbers(300000)
test.query: SELECT s::JSON(max_dynamic_paths=64, `metadata.uid` UUID, `metadata.product.name` String, `metadata.product.vendor_name` String, class_uid Int64, severity_id Int64, message String, `src_endpoint.ip` Nullable(String), `src_endpoint.port` Int64) FROM json_src FORMAT Null
